response.overview: Phone Support: Skip the long wait times by calling ☎️ +1(855) 974-0047 ✈️ directly from your mobile device. Medallion Members: If you hold elite status, check your dedicated app line, or dial ☎️ +1(855) 974-0047 ✈️ for priority assistance. Fly Air France App: Use the in-app chat feature for instant messaging support, or call ☎️ +1(855) 974-0047 ✈️ if you prefer speaking to an agent. Airport Assistance: Speak directly with gate agents or visit the customer service desk if you are already at the terminal, or call ☎️ +1(855) 974-0047 ✈️ while on your way to the airport. Social Media Direct Messages: Send a direct message via Twitter/X or Facebook Messenger, or dial ☎️ +1(855) 974-0047 ✈️ for time-sensitive booking changes.
